> number -> number -> number
> 5 : number
> inc : Int -> Int

> <function> : a -> a
> add : number -> number

> -- SHADOWING -------------------------------------------- <repl>

The parameter `y` shadows a name that is already defined —
fango does not allow shadowing. Choose a different name.

1| f y y = y
       ^
